patterns_observed.state_management: All Zustand stores (12 total). Only useAuth and useTourStore use persist middleware. No Redux or Context API. Each feature has its own store file in hooks/ (named use_*.ts). Some stores delegate API calls to dedicated service files, others call axios directly.
patterns_observed.auth_pattern: useAuth provides global auth state via Zustand persist. Axios interceptors in use_auth.ts add Authorization headers globally AND handle 401 retry with token refresh. Individual services also add auth headers manually (eu_calendar_service.ts). This is a documented inconsistency - CLAUDE.md says no global interceptor exists, but one does exist in use_auth.ts.
patterns_observed.api_pattern: Mixed fetch/axios usage. Most hooks use axios directly; chat_interface.tsx uses native fetch for SSE streaming. Services (eu_calendar_service, consultation_service, prediction_service, mep_amendment_service) are dedicated API clients. Pre-user tracker uses fire-and-forget fetch.
patterns_observed.routing: React Router v6 with BrowserRouter. 18 routes total. ProtectedRoute component shows FeaturePreviewPage for unauthenticated users or redirects to /login. /main is semi-protected (accessible to all, features degrade). Deep linking via ?q=, ?tab=, ?celex= params.
patterns_observed.i18n: 6 languages (en, es, ca, fr, it, nl). useTranslation() hook in most pages. Landing page and subscription page are the most i18n-heavy. Some pages (admin, tenderator) have no i18n and use hardcoded English.
patterns_observed.tier_gating: White/Yellow/Blue tiers control access. MyEUBubblePage checks user.subscription_tier for calendar and consultations. TenderatorPage checks API 403 for blue access. EUComplyPage has no frontend tier check (backend enforced).
patterns_observed.responsive_design: createPortal used for mobile sidebars in EUComplyPage. ProfilePage has mobile overlay navigation. Some pages check window.innerWidth for mobile detection.
patterns_observed.css_pattern: BEM naming with component-scoped CSS files (one .css per .tsx). Global styles in styles/globals.css and styles/fonts.css.

issues_noted.issue: CLAUDE.md says 'No global axios interceptor exists' but use_auth.ts lines 177-213 define both request and response interceptors. The interceptor DOES exist, making the manual authHeaders() pattern in services redundant (but not harmful).
